report.status_line: Critical: Water trailer tank ruptured en route delaying resupply; ~360 L water remaining and propane depletion projected in ~8 days.

concerns.title: Water Resupply Trailer Rupture and Water Scarcity
concerns.detail: At 12:35pm Mission Support reported that the trailer tank ruptured en route, delaying the water resupply mission. Current water is estimated at ~360 L with a static level of 15 cm. For 7 crew members, this volume will last about 4.2 days at the analog average rate of 12.12 L/person/day, or about 20.6 days at the NASA minimum rate of 2.5 L/person/day, while 10 days remain until mission end on 2015-01-23.

concerns.title: Propane Depletion Before Mission End
concerns.detail: Propane is at 40%, dropping -5 percent/day from 45% yesterday. At this rate, propane will be empty in ~8 days, prior to mission end on 2015-01-23 (10 days away). Additionally, hot water has still not been attained.

concerns.title: ATV Mechanical and Electrical Failures
concerns.detail: ATV 3 powered on but shut down after 20 seconds, and ATV 5 failed to start completely, creating vehicle availability constraints ahead of planned EVA operations.

crew_actions: Implement strict water rationing to sustain remaining ~360 L of water until resupply arrives.
Troubleshoot ATV 3 electrical shutdown and ATV 5 startup failure.
Inspect water heater system to address lack of hot water.
Change mattress tie setup and cover with an extra mattress for easier handling with gloves.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve replacement water trailer dispatch and schedule replacement resupply delivery.
decisions_for_earth.why: The trailer tank ruptured en route and current water (~360 L) will only last about 4.2 days at analog average use for 7 crew members.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve or deny the requested EVA scheduled for Jan 14th 2015.
decisions_for_earth.why: ATV 3 and ATV 5 experienced startup failures, affecting mobility and safety redundancy.

decisions_for_earth.decision: Approve propane resupply or implement habitat heating conservation procedures.
decisions_for_earth.why: Propane is at 40% and dropping by -5 percent/day, projecting depletion in ~8 days before the mission ends in 10 days.

report.message_to_earth: Overall status is critical due to a ruptured water trailer tank delaying Hab resupply. At 12:35pm Mission Support reported the resupply trailer tank ruptured en route, leaving ~360 L of total water for 7 crew members, lasting about 4.2 days at average consumption. The crew is conserving water and troubleshooting ATV 3 and ATV 5. Diesel is nominal at 75%, while propane is at 40% and empty in ~8 days without hot water. We request confirmation of a replacement water delivery schedule and decision on the Jan 14 EVA by tomorrow morning. Next report will be sent tomorrow evening.
